subject: Admin trail extraction: query patterns, retention slice, and signed delivery cadence
messages:
From: Laura Simms <laura.simms@healthbridge.com>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.com, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: healthbridge-compliance@healthbridge.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: admin trail extract for SOC 2 evidence (scope Q2-2026)

Hi Sofia / Kimberly,

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier — following up with a formal request from our SOC 2 team. We need a repeatable extract of admin activity covering the period 2026-05-01 through 2026-07-31. Primary asks: what fields are included in the extract, the retention slice model (per-user vs per-tenant), and how signed delivery will be provided for chain-of-custody.

Items we need answered for the auditor by next Friday:
- canonical field list (timestamps, actor, action, resource, session_id, request_id, ip, region, raw_payload link)
- whether ephemeral events (short-lived KV cache ops, ephemeral credentials issuance) are captured and how they are flagged
- retention/aggregation policy for privileged admin actions
- export delivery options (S3 presigned + HMAC, signed manifest, or on-demand streaming)

I've attached a short template our auditor uses — happy to adjust.

Laura
Laura Simms
Director, Compliance — HealthBridge
laura.simms@healthbridge.com

From: sofia.ivanova@redwood.com <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Laura Simms <laura.simms@healthbridge.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood.com, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin trail extract for SOC 2 evidence (scope Q2-2026)

Hi Laura — thanks for the request and the template. Upfront summary: we can provide a per-event export containing the fields you listed, we tag ephemeral events with an "ephemeral=true" flag and include a provenance pointer to the originating session slice. Delivery options we recommend are: 1) S3 presigned URLs + HMAC manifest (for auditor ingestion), 2) an attested manifest signed with our PKI (for chain-of-custody), or 3) a timeboxed streaming handoff for on-site auditors.

Action plan and ETA:
- Today: we’ll validate the exact canonical field list and share a CSV schema by EOD. (attachments: admin_trail_export_spec.xlsx)
- Tomorrow: Kimberly will outline the HMAC/signing cadence and retention carveouts for privileged admin events.
- By Friday: provide a sample 2-day export (anonymized) and signed manifest.

Notes:
- Retention model: default per-tenant event retention is 2 years; privileged admin actions are marked for 5-year preservation on request (policy change requires a delivery SLA addendum).
- Export sampling: we can provide either full period or time-sliced deltas; for auditor consumption we recommend full-period un-sliced export plus an index manifest to allow rehydration.

Putting Kimberly and Jonas on the thread to add technical specifics.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivánova
Manager, Product Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Cc: Laura Simms <laura.simms@healthbridge.com>, jonas.weber@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin trail extract for SOC 2 evidence (scope Q2-2026)

Laura / team — technical details below. I’ve also attached a short instruction file for generating S3 presigned packages we typically hand off to auditors.

Canonical export fields (CSV column name -> description):
- event_ts (ISO 8601 UTC)
- actor_id (internal user id)
- actor_type (human|service|automation)
- action_type (e.g., ROLE_ASSIGN, API_KEY_CREATE, MODEL_DEPLOY)
- resource_path (service/resource canonical id)
- request_id (uuid)
- session_id (session or connection id)
- ip_address
- user_agent
- region
- outcome (SUCCESS|FAIL|RETRY)
- raw_payload_link (s3:// pointer to JSON blob)
- ephemeral (true|false)
- redaction_marker (PII_MASKED|NONE)

Ephemeral events: short-lived events from the runtime (e.g., KV cache trim, ephemeral key issuance) are included and set ephemeral=true. Auditors can filter those out if not in scope.

Retention carveouts:
- Standard events: 730 days (2 years)
- Privileged admin actions (role grants, credential exports, config changes): default 1825 days (5 years) if customer requests preservation; otherwise purged per standard retention

Export packaging & integrity:
- We produce gzipped CSV parts (max 5GB) and a manifest.json.lz4 that lists parts, row counts, and a SHA-256 per part.
- Manifest is signed with our attestation key (PKCS7); we also provide an HMAC key that you can verify locally.
- For FIPS/HSM customers we can provide an HSM-backed signing key (request via support/entitlements).

Delivery cadence options:
1) Scheduled S3 handoff (nightly/weekly) with pre-signed URLs valid for 7 days + HMAC manifest
2) One-off bulk export with PKCS7-signed manifest delivered via secure transfer (SFTP/Box)
3) Short-lived streaming endpoint with signed session token for on-site auditors

I’ve attached: s3-presigned-instructions.txt and a draft signed-manifest.sha256 to illustrate the checksum scheme.

Kimberly Park
Director, Security Engineering — Redwood Inference

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Simms <laura.simms@healthbridge.com>, kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 14:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: admin trail extraction: query patterns, retention slice, and signed delivery cadence

Laura — quick operational notes and schedule. We can run the full-period (2026-05-01 -> 2026-07-31) export as a one-off on Monday 2026-08-24. Deliverables:
- gzipped CSV parts in an S3 bucket (encrypted at rest), pre-signed links with 7-day expiry
- PKCS7-signed manifest and an additional HMAC file for auditor verification
- short README describing how to validate checksums and manifest signatures

If HealthBridge needs extended retention for privileged admin events, please confirm via the attached spec so we can queue the 5-year preservation workflow (this requires a support ticket and entitlement change).

Next steps:
- Laura: confirm delivery option (S3 presigned + HMAC manifest preferred?) and sign the preservation addendum if you want 5-year retention for privileged events.
- Sofia/Kimberly/Jonas: we will prepare the sample export and sample validation steps and share by Friday.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Reliability Engineer — Redwood Inference
